fieldMarks: Male's crest is white with a black border and can be raised high or flattened
Female is uniformly dark with a mostly dark bill and a pale bushy crest at the back of a long flat head
behavior: Dives and hunts by sight for small fish, crayfish and aquatic insects
Cavity nester that readily uses wood duck nest boxes
Mostly a short-distance migrant, moving late in fall and early in spring
habitat: Wooded lakes, ponds, creeks and narrow rivers in forested country; in winter woodland ponds, wooded swamps and fresh or brackish coastal estuaries.
range: Breeds from southeastern Alaska, central British Columbia and southwestern Alberta south to Oregon, Idaho and Montana, and from central Saskatchewan to Nova Scotia south to Kansas, Louisiana and Georgia; winters mainly along the Pacific, Atlantic and Gulf slopes.

lookalikes.name: Bufflehead (male)
lookalikes.howToTell: Compare males closely; the hooded merganser's white crest is bordered with black.
